description: Upgrade the Active Directory domain functional level from Server 2012 R2 to Server 2019 across a multi-site enterprise. The domain spans 3 physical sites with 4 domain controllers (2 at the primary site, 1 at each remote site). The upgrade must follow this order: run adprep /forestprep and adprep /domainprep schema prep, stage by raising the functional level only after schema prep completes and replicates to every DC, sequence FSMO role holder and GC placement, upgrade site-by-site (primary site first, then remote sites with inter-site replication verification between each), and verify per-site before proceeding. A rollback plan must exist in case any site fails to upgrade. Risk factors: functional level raises are irreversible once committed, inter-site replication latency can mask outdated schema, and domain controllers can be accidentally demoted if the DCPromo / role-transfer steps are mis-ordered. Tools available: adprep, ntdsutil, Active Directory Users and Computers, repadmin, dcdiag, PowerShell AD module.
